messages.subject: Time recording – April narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

A reminder that April time needs to be posted by 12:00 on 2 May for the monthly bill run. Several matters still show gaps. Please also add narratives to any unnarrated entries – the billing partners have asked for fuller descriptions this quarter.

Thank you,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
